userStories.title: Pure chat timeline merger
userStories.description: As an operator, I want parent-conversation user turns and qualifying run lifecycle events merged chronologically into timeline entries, so that the run Chat tab shows user inputs and node status progressions without assistant clutter or transcript spam.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-chat-timeline.ts exporting ChatTimelineNodeStatus, ChatTimelineEntry, and buildChatTimeline(input): ChatTimelineEntry[].
Include parent-conversation messages only when role === 'user' and trimmed content is non-empty; assistant messages and blank user turns are omitted.

Map lifecycle events node_started to status 'running' and detail 'started'; node_completed to status 'completed' and detail 'completed'; node_failed to status 'failed' and detail 'failed'; node_skipped and node_skipped_prior_success to status 'skipped' and detail 'skipped'; approval_requested to status 'running' and detail 'gate requested' with selection { kind: 'node' }.

Map loop iteration events loop_iteration_started, loop_iteration_completed, and loop_iteration_failed with safe integer iteration >= 1 to running/completed/failed status, detail 'iteration N started/completed/failed', and selection { kind: 'loop_iteration', iteration: N }.

Map node_routed with positive safe integer execution_seq to status 'completed', detail 'routed {outcome} → {to}', and selection { kind: 'route_iteration', executionSeq }; fall back to selection { kind: 'node' } and 'unknown' tokens if execution_seq is missing or invalid.
Skip events when both step_name and data.nodeId fail to yield a non-empty string node ID, and skip loop events with iteration < 1.
Omit tool_called, tool_completed, workflow_artifact, node_awaiting, interaction_resolved, and all other non-whitelisted event types.
Set node label preferring nodeStates name for that nodeId over the raw id, appending ' ×N' for loop_iteration and ' #N' for route_iteration.
Resolve nodeType by calling the injected resolveNodeType(nodeId) for every included node-status entry (never called for user entries).
Sort entries ascending by ensureUtc timestamp (non-finite treated as 0), breaking ties with kind === 'user' before 'node_status', then encounter index.
Ensure no generated entry has status 'awaiting' and no generated detail contains 'awaiting'.
Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-chat-timeline.test.ts covering all 18 specified unit test cases, passing with bun test src/components/workflows/build-chat-timeline.test.ts.
userStories.technicalNotes: Follow docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-06-node-room-from-chat-timeline-legacy.md:145-222, 459-684. Consumes MessageResponse, WorkflowEventResponse, WorkflowNodeStateResponse from @/lib/api, LogRowSelection from ./build-log-rows, NodeBodyKind from ./resolve-room-kind, and ensureUtc from @/lib/format. Pure function without React dependencies.
userStories.notes: Implemented in iteration 1. Files: packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-chat-timeline.ts, packages/web/src/components/workflows/build-chat-timeline.test.ts. 18 tests passing.

userStories.title: Timeline node status to LogRow room resolution
userStories.description: As an operator, I want clicking a timeline node-status entry to resolve to the exact matching LogRow, so that the Chat door opens the identical per-type node room as Logs and Graph.
acceptanceCriteria: Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/resolve-timeline-room-row.ts exporting resolveTimelineRoomRow(input: { rows: readonly LogRow[]; entry: Extract<ChatTimelineEntry, { kind: 'node_status' }>; liveStatus: readonly GraphRoomLiveStatus[]; }): LogRow.

Scan input.rows in reverse to find the last LogRow whose nodeId equals entry.nodeId and whose selection matches entry.selection via selectionsEqual (handling 'node', 'loop_iteration' by iteration, and 'route_iteration' by executionSeq).
If no exact row matches, fall back to resolveGraphRoomRow({ rows: input.rows, nodeId: input.entry.nodeId, liveStatus: input.liveStatus }).
Throw an explicit Error ('Timeline node selection did not resolve a room row') if resolveGraphRoomRow returns null, ensuring the function always returns a non-null LogRow.

Create packages/web/src/components/workflows/resolve-timeline-room-row.test.ts covering ordinary rows, loop iteration matching, route iteration matching, graph room fallback, ignoring unrelated nodes, and verifying returned nodeId === entry.nodeId.
Passes with bun test src/components/workflows/resolve-timeline-room-row.test.ts.

Consumes LogRow from ./build-log-rows, ChatTimelineEntry from ./build-chat-timeline, GraphRoomLiveStatus and resolveGraphRoomRow from ./resolve-graph-room-row. Pure function without state.

userStories.description: As an operator, I want an accessible presentational timeline in the Chat left pane, so that I can review chronological user bubbles and clickable node-status buttons with accurate type glyphs and active status highlights.

Render 'Loading conversation turns…' when loading is true and entries is empty.
Render error text with className="text-error" when error is non-null while still rendering entries.
Render 'No conversation turns or node-status entries yet.' when not loading, error is null, and entries is empty.

Render user entries as non-button <div> elements with classes 'ml-auto max-w-[80%] rounded-lg bg-accent/20 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-text-primary whitespace-pre-wrap', escaping HTML content as plain text.
Render node-status entries as <button type="button"> elements calling onSelectNodeStatus(entry) when clicked.
Assign aria-current="true" to the node-status button whose id === selectedEntryId (and only that button).

Render node-status button contents in exact order: node-type icon (Zap for command, FileText for prompt, RefreshCw for loop, Terminal for bash/script, Eye for approval/plannotator_gate, Workflow for workflow, GitBranch for route_loop, Box for loop_group, Bot for unknown; aria-hidden="true", h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-text-tertiary), node label, detail, status badge matching NodeRunList classes, formatStarted(createdAt), and ChevronRight icon (h-3 w-3 text-text-tertiary).

userStories.title: Wire Chat door into LegacyGraphLogsPane with parent queries and send
userStories.description: As an operator, I want LegacyGraphLogsPane to host the Chat timeline and composer as a third door into the shared node room, so that Graph, Logs, and Chat share selection and live node rooms without switching tabs.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend LegacyGraphLogsPaneProps in packages/web/src/components/workflows/LegacyGraphLogsPane.tsx to accept activeView: 'graph' | 'logs' | 'chat', parentPlatformId: string | null, loadParentMessages: (conversationId: string) => Promise<MessageResponse[]>, loadParentConversation: (conversationId: string) => Promise<ConversationResponse>, and sendParentMessage: (conversationId: string, message: string) => Promise<{ accepted: boolean; status: string }>.
Export runChatMessagesRefetchInterval(status: WorkflowRunStatus): 3000 | false returning 3000 for 'pending', 'running', 'paused', and false for 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled'.

Query parent messages via useQuery with key ['runChatMessages', parentPlatformId], enabled when activeView === 'chat' && parentPlatformId !== null, refetchInterval from runChatMessagesRefetchInterval(runStatus), and retry: false.
Query parent conversation via useQuery with key ['runChatConversation', parentPlatformId], enabled when activeView === 'chat' && parentPlatformId !== null, staleTime: Infinity, and retry: false.

Derive composerDisabledReason: 'Conversation unavailable.' if parentPlatformId === null; 'Loading conversation…' if fetching; 'Unable to load conversation details.' if query fails; 'Continuing chats from other platforms in the Web UI is coming soon' if platform_type !== 'web'; otherwise null.

Manage chatDraft, chatSending, and chatSendError state; on submit, call sendParentMessage, clear draft and refetch parentMessagesQuery on success; preserve draft and display error on failure; invalidate pending send generations on runId changes.
Manage selectedTimelineEntryId state; clear it on Graph click, Logs click, run change, or external node selection change; preserve it across tab switches between Graph, Logs, and Chat.

Implement handleNodeStatusSelect: resolve room row with resolveTimelineRoomRow, set selectedLogRowId if row exists in rows (or null if synthetic fallback), set selectedTimelineEntryId(entry.id), and call onSelectNode(row.nodeId).
Render left pane with three-way branch: 'graph' renders renderGraph, 'logs' renders NodeRunList, 'chat' renders ChatTimeline inside min-h-0 flex-1 and RunChatComposer at bottom.
